fees.description: This fee may apply when disconnecting power to your property. Additional charges may be incurred for after hours requests, site-visits and non-payment cases. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.

This fee may apply when reconnecting power to your property. Additional charges may be incurred for after hours requests,  site-visits and non-payment cases. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.

This fee may apply when the network is requested to visit site and undertake a special meter read. This fee may also apply to any move in or out that does not require reconnection or disconnections. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.

electricityContract.terms: This offer is available to customers with an applicable network tariff. If you are not sure which network tariff you have, please contact us or sign up online to check this offer is available to you. Billing will be either monthly or quarterly, depending on your meter type. For more details on the terms and conditions, visit nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/#contracts, contact Nectr on hello@nectr.com.au or call 1300 111 211.

discounts.description: $50 credit on your 2nd bill, if you sign up using a Refer a Friend link from an existing Nectr customer. Applies to new customers only. T&Cs apply, refer to nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/nectr-refer-a-friend-program/

electricityContract.variation: We may vary your rates and charges once every 12 months by providing you notice of any changes at least 5 business days before they become effective.

incentives.description: 100% GreenPower is included as part of your plan.

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: Additional fees and charges may apply. Please see the Nectr fee schedules at nectr.com.au/plans-and-fees/evoenergy/.
